purpose: Public-fixture failure audit; no training or threshold selection
groundTruthLimitations: Historical author mechanical-water corpus; physical-meter/site independence is unknown.
Supplied diagnostic records contain no decimal/register ground truth or body/display coordinate comparisons. Source OBB labels exist but crop accuracy is not measured by this join.
Unknown-digit ('u') annotations mean incomplete numeric ground truth, not verified unreadability.
Correct Stage2 sequences rejected by fusion are recovery candidates; they do not authorize bypassing disagreement or scene guards.
Stage audit is an earlier diagnostic run; its fusedValue is deliberately ignored. Runtime outcomes come from the supplied current report.
Runtime rows have no per-image hashes; the filename join uses a pinned manifest and optionally verifies the current image/label corpus.

meter_classification_failure.definition: Classification did not resolve a complete category; not necessarily a wrong class.
meter_classification_failure.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

incorrect_meter_bounding_box.definition: Incorrectness needs reviewed body-box ground truth; invalid geometry alone is a symptom.
incorrect_meter_bounding_box.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

incorrect_reading_display_localization.definition: Display localization was rejected; exact crop correctness needs reviewed polygons.
incorrect_reading_display_localization.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

incomplete_digit_detection.definition: Digit assembly rejected or sequence length differs; missing detections are not a proven cause.
incomplete_digit_detection.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

incorrect_digit_order.definition: Equal digit multisets with a different sequence are only an ordering candidate.
incorrect_digit_order.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

incorrect_register_selection.definition: Unverified/contradictory register evidence; actual wrong-register selection needs register ground truth.
incorrect_register_selection.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

precision_decimal_ambiguity.definition: Decimal evidence is missing or inconsistent; digit-only accuracy is not billing accuracy.
precision_decimal_ambiguity.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

fusion_disagreement.definition: Runtime fusion veto or differing nonempty PP/Stage2 strings; guards remain in force.
fusion_disagreement.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

parser_rejection.definition: Runtime/parser reported an unrecognized, ambiguous, or contradictory reading.
parser_rejection.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

correctly_rejected_unreadable_input.definition: Count only explicit reviewed unreadable ground truth, never merely an unknown digit label.
correctly_rejected_unreadable_input.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts

unnecessary_fallback.definition: A correct intermediate sequence is a recovery candidate, not proof it was safe to emit.
unnecessary_fallback.countMeaning: nonexclusive observations, not proven root-cause counts
